dict.string: Health Engine reads resting heart rate, HRV, sleep, VO2 max, respiratory rate and wrist temperature from Health to compute your baselines. Everything is processed on your device.
Health Engine reads meeting hours and schedule shape from your calendar, on-device, to look for associations with your physiology.
Health Engine uses infrequent, significant location changes to estimate time spent away from home and timezone shifts. It never tracks continuous location.

Health Engine reads your recent activity history (stationary, walking, automotive) to look for associations with your physiology. Only the last 7 days are ever available, and everything is processed on your device.
